# TG68K.C vendored source

Source: <https://github.com/TobiFlex/TG68K.C>, commit `ade33e3`.

The three VHDL files in this directory are vendored unmodified. Their source headers identify Tobias Gubener and other
contributors and license the files under GNU LGPL version 3 or later. NB-1-specific integration is outside this directory in
`rtl/nb1/nb1_cpu.sv`.
